qualified_nonvoting_hebrew_audit.exposure: known three chapter-sized fallback scaffold rows only

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Defend or concede from form and discourse markers without deciding authorship, date, locust taxonomy, event identity, or witness; preserve LOW confidence and the larger parent.
decision_challenges.challenge: Second-guess the merger of superscription, hearer summons, generational transmission, and fourfold loss refrain; the canonical primary separates 1:1 from 1:2-4, while the larger 1:1-20 disaster-lament parent remains live.
decision_challenges.material_basis: The word-event formula is formally complete at 1:1, but hear/listen, the memory question, tell-to-generations chain, and cumulative remainder catalogue bind 1:2-4.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Test address and form changes while refusing disaster reconstruction, gendered-image doctrine, crop-list atomization, or cultic authority.
decision_challenges.challenge: Audit whether the serial wake/wail/lament address circuit is too broad or should absorb 1:13; audiences, crops, trees, and imperatives must not be atomized, but the priestly sackcloth summons may be a real seam.
decision_challenges.material_basis: Wake and wail open cumulative addressee and agricultural-loss sequences; gird yourselves with sackcloth at 1:13 redirects the response to priests.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Keep the seam unresolved if alarm continuity outweighs the trumpet reset; choose no chronology, disaster mechanism, ritual mandate, or theology.
decision_challenges.challenge: Apply maximum seam pressure at Joel.1.13-Joel.2.1: decide whether priestly lament, fast/assembly, day cry, stores and animals, and direct prayer close at 1:20 or whether the trumpet command at 2:1 continues the same day-alarm parent.
decision_challenges.material_basis: Sackcloth/consecrate/assemble imperatives and Alas for the day organize 1:13-20; Blow the trumpet in Zion resets addressee and acoustic form at 2:1, yet day-of-YHWH language bridges the seam.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Preserve the full alarm-host parent unless an external reviewer demonstrates a stronger non-chapter literary seam; no entity, event, chronology, warfare, or fulfillment ruling.
decision_challenges.challenge: Challenge whether trumpet alarm, advancing-host similes, ordered movement, cosmic disturbance, and the climactic endurance question form one unit or require internal division; identity of locusts, nation, army, host, and divine agency cannot decide.
decision_challenges.material_basis: Trumpet/day formula launches the sequence; similes and motion accumulate until the great-day question at 2:11, while 2:12 pivots with Yet even now.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Defend both edge seams without making repentance, fasting, assembly, divine mutability, quotation, or ritual authority decisions.
decision_challenges.challenge: Audit whether return appeal, character formula, renewed trumpet, whole-community assembly, and quoted priestly intercession should remain together; place special pressure at 2:11-12 and 2:17-18.
decision_challenges.material_basis: Yet even now answers the endurance question; return imperatives flow to a second trumpet and assembly, then priests supply the climactic plea. The turning/answer begins at 2:18 but its aspect and narrative force remain disputed.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Retain the larger restoration parent and LOW confidence unless phrase/discourse evidence compels a split; select no reading, referent, witness, fulfillment, or theology.
decision_challenges.challenge: Second-guess the response-restoration parent at 2:18-27, especially internal pressures at 2:20-21, 2:22-23, and 2:27-28; rain/teacher wording, aspect, northern-one identity, and never-again language cannot authorize a seam.
decision_challenges.material_basis: The turning introduces provisions and removal; calls to land, animals, and Zion, rain/harvest restitution, satisfaction, and recognition/no-shame refrains form a reversal sequence. Afterward at 2:28 begins a new proclamation.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Preserve local WEB coordinates and the larger proclamation while deferring numbering superiority, ruach sense, fulfillment, Spirit doctrine, salvation mechanics, remnant identity, and later-reuse authority.
decision_challenges.challenge: Apply explicit English/Hebrew numbering pressure at 2:27-28 and 2:32-3:1: English 2:28-32 corresponds to Hebrew chapter 3, but neither numbering scheme may decide whether outpouring, signs, day formula, invocation, escape, and remnant stand apart from the nations scene.
decision_challenges.material_basis: Afterward opens repeated outpouring and inclusive recipient pairs; signs, before-the-day clause, calling, and escape/remnant formula close the proclamation. For behold, in those days at 3:1 resumes restoration language while opening nations gathering.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Prefer the larger lawsuit movement unless address shift proves decisive; make no geography, ethnic, slavery, violence, retaliation, event, chronology, or fulfillment judgment.
decision_challenges.challenge: Audit both Joel.2.32-Joel.3.1 continuity and the direct-address transition inside 3:1-8; restoration frame, nations gathering, lawsuit, traded-person indictment, and repayment oracle may be one parent or two genuine address units.
decision_challenges.material_basis: In those days links backward while introducing gathering and judgment; what are you to me narrows addressees at 3:4, but repayment completes the accusation-consequence sequence.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Keep one escalating scene unless speaker/form evidence defeats it; no holy-war mandate, nation identity, modern application, harvest chronology, divine-agency ethic, or fulfillment claim.
decision_challenges.challenge: Challenge the merger of war summons, counter-summons, judicial sitting, harvest/winepress, valley multitudes, cosmic darkening, roar, and refuge; apply special pressure at 3:8-9, 3:11-12, and 3:16-17.
decision_challenges.material_basis: Proclaim this among the nations resets discourse at 3:9; imperative escalation reaches judicial and harvest scenes, then cosmic signs and Zion roar culminate in refuge. So you will know at 3:17 opens the closing recognition tableau.

decision_challenges.requested_resolution: Preserve the whole coda and LOW confidence unless external review resolves form; choose no temple/land blueprint, modern geography, collective guilt, blood-clause reading, permanence, violence ethic, or theology.
decision_challenges.challenge: Audit whether recognition, Zion dwelling, abundance, fountain, Egypt/Edom desolation, Judah/Jerusalem continuity, blood crux, and final dwelling refrain are over-merged; larger closure at 3:16-21 remains live.
decision_challenges.material_basis: So you will know pivots to a closing tableau, and dwelling language frames the coda; contrasts and the difficult blood clause create internal pressure without supplying a secure seam.

global_hold_challenges.scope: all 22 canonical-primary overlaps and 10 canonical relation groups
global_hold_challenges.challenge: Canonical relations may support parent context only; they cannot force dependence direction, identity, chronology, typology, fulfillment, canon, graph edges, theology, or a boundary.

Hebrew morphology, accents, wording, wordplay, discourse formulas, translation, versions, and numbering are evidence only; roots are not meanings, and no reading, witness, speaker, referent, or boundary is selected.
Preservation is complete but is not reconciliation or consensus; every competing span remains available for author response, boss review, appeal, and external/human adjudication.
Macro parents, anti-oversplit guards, hot zones, premortem holds, relation groups, and witness/translation guards must survive resolution without being flattened into majority agreement.

global_hold_challenges.scope: Joel.1.13-Joel.2.1; Joel.2.11-Joel.2.12; Joel.2.17-Joel.2.18; Joel.2.27-Joel.3.1; Joel.3.8-Joel.3.9; Joel.3.16-Joel.3.17
global_hold_challenges.challenge: Cross-chapter, temporal, speaker, response, and recognition seams remain contested; chapter and Hebrew/English versification coordinates guarantee coverage but do not adjudicate literary attachment.

global_hold_challenges.scope: all locust, army, northern-one, disaster, day, nations, valley, harvest, Spirit, remnant, land, Zion, and restoration pressure zones
global_hold_challenges.challenge: No route may decide entity identity, event, history, authorship/date, chronology, fulfillment, ethics, ritual mandate, doctrine, modern geography, politics, canon, source tradition, or theology.

The audit saw only the known three chapter-fallback rows and supplied no positive route exposure; retain its 20 overlaps solely as qualified non-voting challenge evidence and exclude it from clean-primary count, consensus, and promotion claims.
The zero-byte serialization failure is zero evidence: it contributes no vote, support, challenge, disagreement resolution, coverage, or postcheck approval.
Every meso-unit must remain defensible inside Joel.1.1-1.20, Joel.2.1-2.17, Joel.2.18-2.27, and Joel.2.28-3.21; if a seam remains unresolved, keep the larger unit, lower confidence, and queue it.
